title: Entitled Woman Turns Restaurant Complain Into Arrest
description:
“Go to https://TryFum.com/POLICEINSIDER and use code POLICEINSIDER to get a discount off your order today.”


On August 7th, 2022, officers were dispatched to a restaurant in reference to a disorderly female who was threatening employees that she was going to throw her milkshake at them. The female refused to provide her information and when she attempted to run, the officers had no option but to tackle her. Soon, more officers arrived on the scene to investigate the incident. The sergeant then instructed the officers to collect information from the witnesses who were inside the restaurant. The sergeant then proceeded to talk to the employees who were adamant on pressing charges on the female. While going through the female’s purse, an officer found some potentially illicit substances. The sergeant informed the female of her offence and charges. The female was charged with resisting or obstructing, concealing identity and assault. She was also trespassed from the restaurant

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
